strategy.name: TJR Liquidity Sweep
strategy.description: A rule-based version of the popular liquidity sweep and fair value gap style. Traders say stop-losses pile up just beyond obvious highs and lows, and that price often runs those levels and then reverses. The bot waits for price to run the previous day's high or low (or a high or low from earlier today) and snap back, for the 5-minute chart to shift structure the other way, and for price to pull back into a gap on the 1-minute chart. Then it trades in the new direction with the stop beyond the sweep. The whole account goes into one position at a time, and each trade is closed within the hour. This is an automated approximation of a style that is normally traded by eye, so the results say whether this version works, not the whole idea.
strategy.schedule: Checks every minute. Enters between 9:40 AM and 11:30 AM ET and after 1:30 PM ET, never in the last 40 minutes, and closes everything 10 minutes before the close.
rules: Sweep: price runs past the previous day's high or low, or a high or low from earlier today, then closes back inside within a few minutes.
Structure shift: a finished 5-minute candle closes beyond the recent swing, in the opposite direction of the sweep.
Fair value gap: on the 1-minute chart, a three-bar gap forms after the sweep. The bot enters when price comes back into it.
Sweep of a low means long, sweep of a high means short. The stop goes just beyond the sweep.
Take-profit at 2 times the risk. Closed after 60 minutes at most, and before the market closes.
The whole account goes into one position at a time. If several stocks set up together, the cleanest setup is taken.
